subject: E-6155: token rejected on Windows
body:
Hi, I'm using Tallyboard 1.9.1 on Windows 11 23H2. Starting yesterday, the
moment I open the app a dialog reads "E-6155: authentication token rejected".

The clock has been wrong since the battery was replaced. Websites complain about
certificates too, so it might be related.

I've already tried restarting the machine, which changed nothing.

Regards, Sofia Rossi, Tessa Labs
